content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry, for episode ep-05032. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. Authorization status is recorded as missing, and this appeal with supporting clinical documentation is submitted 47 days after service, within the 133 days remaining to the filing deadline."}
